data.name: Babar
data.gender_notes: Babar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Babar is a Persian-origin name meaning 'lion', symbolizing strength, leadership, and courage. It is famously associated with Zahir-ud-din Muhammad Babar, the founder of the Mughal Empire in the Indian subcontinent. The name Babar carries the meaning “Lion, Brave Leader” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Babar usually hope their child will grow to embody lion, brave leader and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents fearless leadership, nobility, and a heart that commands respect through justice and vision.
data.etymology: Babar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion, Brave Leader.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Babar total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: ببر
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من ببر يعني الأسد أو الحيوان القوي
in_arabic.long_meaning: ببر هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الأسد أو الحيوان القوي، و هو من الأسماء التي تدل على الشجاعة و القوة. ورد في القرآن الكريم ذكر الأسد في عدة مواضع، و في الحديث النبوي الشريف عدة روايات عن الأسد كرمز للقوة.

in_urdu.name: ببر
in_urdu.meaning: ببر کا مطلب ہے شیر یا مضبوط جانور
in_urdu.long_meaning: ببر ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے شیر یا مضبوط جانور۔ یہ نام شجاعت اور قوت کی علامت ہے۔ اسلامی روایات میں شیر کی اہمیت کا ذکر کیا گیا ہے، خاص طور پر قرآن مجید میں اس کا ذکر مختلف مضامین میں آیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: बबर
in_hindi.meaning: बबर का अर्थ है शेर या मजबूत जानवर
in_hindi.long_meaning: बबर एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ है शेर या मजबूत जानवर। यह नाम वीरता और शक्ति का प्रतीक है। इस्लामी परंपराओं में शेर का महत्व बताया गया है, विशेष रूप से कुरआन में इसकी चर्चा विभिन्न संदर्भों में की गई है।

in_pashto.name: ببر
in_pashto.meaning: ببر د معنی دی چی د شیر یا پیاوړی ژونده
in_pashto.long_meaning: ببر یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی او د معنی یې ده شیر یا پیاوړی ژونده. دا نوم د زړورتیا او پیاوړتیا نښه ده. په اسلامي روایاتو کې د شیر اهمیت بیان شوی دی، په ځانګړي ډول قرآن کريم کې د هغې یادونه په مختلفو موضوعاتو کې شوې ده.

in_english.name: Babar
in_english.meaning: Babar means lion or strong animal, symbolizing courage and power
in_english.long_meaning: Babar is a masculine name derived from Arabic roots, signifying lion or strong animal. It embodies courage and strength, values highly esteemed in Islamic tradition. The lion is mentioned in the Quran and Hadith as a symbol of bravery and might. Historically, the name Babar has been used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting its enduring appeal as a symbol of heroism and resilience.

data.cultural_impact: Babar is a significant name in Islamic and South Asian history, as it represents the beginning of the Mughal Empire. This empire is renowned for its artistic, architectural, and cultural contributions to the Indian subcontinent for over 300 years. The name Babar emphasizes strength and leadership, as its bearer experienced the conquests of Afghanistan, present-day Pakistan, and India, marking the power and influence of this renowned ruler.
data.spiritual_significance: Babar is also significant in a spiritual sense, as the Sufi poem "Maspirita Masnas" suggests. The poem speaks of "Babar, the steadfast, the ever-devoted, who draws nectar from the sacred Hosts," reminding us of the spiritual aspect of the name. Thelapidary "Steadfast and Ever-Devoted One" embodies the unwavering spiritual commitment expected of all believers. This connection highlights the enduring balance and unity between Babar's conquering strength and the deeply spiritual nature of his name and character.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Babar: The Gate or Doorkeeper to the Garden of God. His name signifies a protector and an opener of doors to the divine realm.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Babar was the founder of the Mughal Empire in India in the 16th century. The name Babar carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Babar was a Central Asian warrior who conquered India and established the Mughal Empire in 1526. He was the first Mughal Emperor and is considered the founder of the Mughal Dynasty, which ruled India until 1857.

trends: Babar is a popular name in Pakistan and India
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Babar is of Central Asian origin and has been in use for centuries. In modern times, it has become a popular name in Pakistan and India, particularly among the Muslim population. It is also used in genealogy research and on social media platforms to connect people with common ancestry.
